name: Cameroon
flagHint: Green, red and yellow vertical stripes with a yellow star
funFact: Cameroon is nicknamed "Africa in miniature" for its wide variety of landscapes and cultures.

name: Canada
flagHint: Red borders around a white square holding a red maple leaf
funFact: Canada has the longest coastline of any country in the world.

name: Central African Republic
flagHint: Four horizontal stripes crossed by a red vertical stripe and yellow star
funFact: This landlocked country has French and Sango as its official languages.

name: Chad
flagHint: Blue, yellow and red vertical stripes
funFact: Lake Chad, which gave the country its name, has shrunk dramatically since the 1960s.

name: Chile
flagHint: White over red halves with a blue square holding a white star
funFact: Chile is extremely long and narrow, stretching over 4,000 kilometres from north to south.

name: China
flagHint: Red field with one large yellow star and four small ones
funFact: China shares land borders with 14 other countries.

name: Colombia
flagHint: Wide yellow band over narrower blue and red bands
funFact: Colombia has coastlines on both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.

name: Comoros
flagHint: Four horizontal stripes, green triangle holding a white crescent and stars
funFact: Comoros is an island nation in the Indian Ocean between Mozambique and Madagascar.

name: Congo
flagHint: Green, yellow and red separated by diagonal stripes
funFact: Brazzaville and Kinshasa face each other across the Congo River, the closest pair of national capitals.

name: Costa Rica
flagHint: Five stripes: blue, white, wide red, white, blue, with emblem
funFact: Costa Rica abolished its standing army in 1948.

name: Croatia
flagHint: Red, white and blue stripes with a checkered shield under crowns
funFact: Croatia has over 1,000 islands along its Adriatic coast.

name: Cuba
flagHint: Five blue and white stripes with a red triangle and white star
funFact: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean.

name: Cyprus
flagHint: White field with a copper-orange island map above two olive branches
funFact: Cyprus is the third-largest island in the Mediterranean Sea.

name: Czechia
flagHint: White over red halves with a blue triangle at the hoist
funFact: Czechia is famous for its beer and consistently ranks among the top for beer drinking per person.

name: Denmark
flagHint: Red field with a white Nordic cross
funFact: Its flag, the Dannebrog, is among the oldest continuously used national flags in the world.

name: Djibouti
flagHint: Light blue over green with a white triangle and red star
funFact: Djibouti is home to Lake Assal, one of the lowest points on land in Africa.

name: Dominica
flagHint: Green field, three-colour cross, red disc with a purple parrot
funFact: Dominica's flag is one of the very few national flags to feature the colour purple.

name: Dominican Republic
flagHint: Blue and red quarters split by a white cross with a central emblem
funFact: It shares the island of Hispaniola with Haiti.

name: DR Congo
flagHint: Sky blue with a yellow star and a red diagonal stripe
funFact: It is the largest country in Sub-Saharan Africa by area.

name: Ecuador
flagHint: Wide yellow band over blue and red bands with a central crest
funFact: Ecuador is named after the equator, which runs through the country.

name: Egypt
flagHint: Red, white and black horizontal stripes with a golden eagle
funFact: The vast majority of Egyptians live along the banks of the Nile River.

name: El Salvador
flagHint: Blue, white, blue horizontal stripes with a round emblem
funFact: It is the smallest country in Central America and the only one without a Caribbean coast.

name: Equatorial Guinea
flagHint: Green, white and red stripes with a blue triangle and crest
funFact: It is the only country in Africa where Spanish is an official language.

name: Eritrea
flagHint: Green and blue triangles with a red triangle holding a gold wreath
funFact: Its capital Asmara was named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2017 for its modernist architecture.

name: Estonia
flagHint: Blue, black and white horizontal stripes
funFact: Estonia was one of the first countries to offer nationwide internet voting, in 2005.

name: Eswatini
flagHint: Blue, yellow and red bands with a black-and-white shield and spears
funFact: Eswatini was officially renamed from Swaziland in 2018.

name: Ethiopia
flagHint: Green, yellow and red stripes with a blue disc and yellow star
funFact: Ethiopia uses its own calendar, which runs roughly seven to eight years behind the Gregorian one.

name: Fiji
flagHint: Light blue field with Union Jack and a heraldic shield
funFact: Fiji is made up of more than 300 islands.

name: Finland
flagHint: White field with a blue Nordic cross
funFact: Finland is known as the land of a thousand lakes, with roughly 188,000 of them.

name: France
flagHint: Blue, white and red vertical stripes
funFact: France is consistently one of the most visited countries in the world.
